title: sim.tick payload
description: One simulation step, streamed to a console. Note the deliberate separation of actual and perceived progress: the two are different quantities and the model never conflates them.

integrity.description: Modelled tissue integrity as a fraction of the ceiling.

damage.description: Remaining damage as a fraction, i.e. 1 - integrity where the ceiling is 1.

perceived_progress.description: How much progress the modelled mind believes it has made. Deliberately distinct from 'integrity'.

applied_repair.description: Integrity added by the repair rule during this step. The only quantity the subconscious system is allowed to write.

mediators.description: Mediator channel values: growth_factor, cytokine, perfusion, neural_drive, atp.

rates.description: Repair rate decomposition, including the attention-attributable component. A model decomposition, not a measurement.
